title: Episode 1 cutscene player and quest handoff
head: ron/Alliworld-episode-1-cutscene
body:
## Summary
- Adds a YouTube-based Episode 1 cutscene overlay with home-movie style captions, progress bar, and dev preview/skip shortcuts.
- Wires the cafe beat into a post-clip handoff: black hold, fade to black, Episode 2 title card, and world fade-in at The 5ive.
- Introduces quest transition UI and renames the quest to Midnight's Story (Episode 2: trust the signal).

## Test plan
- [ ] Shift+1: play E1 cutscene, confirm video, captions, and progress bar
- [ ] Shift+E: skip to end; confirm 5s hold, 1.5s fade to black, title card, and 1.6s world fade-in
- [ ] Cafe flow: finish cafe scene → cutscene → Episode 2 transition → spawn at The 5ive
- [ ] First visit to San Bruno shows Episode 1 title card
